core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Firas corresponds to the Arabic form فِراس (Arabic root ف ر س (f-r-s)). Its core sense is lion, brave. Firas (فِراس) is an Arabic male name from the root ف ر س (f-r-s), associated with the lion and with keen perception — classical lexicographers gloss it 'lion' and connect it to فراسة (farāsa) 'perspicacity, discernment'. It was borne by several companions of the Prophet (Firas bin Habis al-Tamimi and others). The source gloss 'bringer of peace' is unsupported and has been replaced.
